title: Hessian-guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Escaping Saddle Points
tldr_zh: PWGF 沿 Wasserstein Hessian 最小特征方向注入 GP 扰动，给出测度空间非凸优化二阶最优性保证
tldr_en: PWGF injects Hessian-guided GP perturbations to escape saddle points in Wasserstein space with polynomial-time second-order guarantees
